svg.title: B-vac workflow: from bacterial proteome to prioritized vaccine candidates
svg.desc: A three-stage vertical workflow. Stage 1, input: a bacterial proteome in FASTA format. Stage 2, configurable screening with four adjustable analysis modules arranged in a two-by-two grid: subcellular localization, non-host homology, virulence factors, and epitope mapping. Stage 3, output: prioritized vaccine candidate proteins with mapped B-cell and T-cell epitopes.
